home.heroTitle: A <highlight>FREE</highlight> educational game to play <highlight>ONLINE</highlight> with your friends and learn History in a fun way.
home.heroSubtitle: Travel through time, organize historical events and participate in quick challenges in cooperative matches.
home.downloadSubtitle: TimeCrax Machine is under development. Soon you will be able to download the beta version for computer and integrate the themes created on the platform.
home.contactSubtitle: Want to use TimeCrax Machine in your school, test the beta version or send suggestions? Get in touch and let's talk.
home.emailDescription: For general questions, school partnerships and game feedback:
home.socialDescription: Follow news about development, tests and new themes:

slides.slide1Text: Explore themed timelines, organizing events correctly to prevent the time machine from collapsing.
slides.slide2Text: Create rooms to play online. Discuss decisions, share knowledge and define the best strategy to win
slides.slide3Text: To place the event on the timeline, you must complete different challenges about that event.

activities.activity2: Analysis and identification of project weaknesses
activities.activity4: Meetings with experts for suggestions and project guidance
activities.activity8: Internal playability and general functionality tests
activities.activity9: Construction of instruments for data collection inside and outside the game
activities.activity10: Final adjustments to the test version
activities.activity11: Review and adjustments of ethical and legal issues
activities.activity12: Mapping suitable locations for test execution
activities.activity13: Pilot application of tests in real contexts and analysis of collected data
activities.activity14: Implementation of improvements based on results
activities.activity17: Writing scientific articles and final report
activities.activity18: Submission of papers to specialized journals
activities.activity19: Dissemination of studies at specialized conferences
activities.activity20: Creation of support materials for teachers to use the game in the classroom

risk1.title: Risk 1: Difficulty finding available experts in the city of Bragança.
risk1.mitigation: Mitigation: Search for experts in nearby cities, or hold meetings via online platforms.

risk2.title: Risk 2: Not finding satisfactory techniques that fit the TimeCrax Machine project.
risk2.mitigation: Mitigation: Search for new techniques or adjust/adapt the project.

risk1.title: Risk 1: Development delays due to technical problems.
risk1.mitigation: Mitigation: Adopt agile methodologies (SCRUM) and divide tasks into sprints.

risk2.title: Risk 2: Insufficient feedback from pilot tests.
risk2.mitigation: Mitigation: Conduct tests in multiple schools with varied profiles.

risk1.title: Risk 1: Unable to find local schools available to participate in the project.
risk1.mitigation: Mitigation: Search for schools in nearby cities for test application.

risk2.title: Risk 2: Inconsistent data due to methodological failures.
risk2.mitigation: Mitigation: Methodology review and expert guidance.

risk1.title: Risk 1: Statistically inconclusive results.
risk1.mitigation: Mitigation: Use mixed methods for data triangulation.

risk2.title: Risk 2: Difficulty publishing in high-impact journals.
